Each shop was checked open on its Google Maps listing or own site, Oct 30, 2026 (the six east and southeast lakes Oct 31, 2026; the six northeast lakes Nov 3, 2026; Grand Lake St. Marys, Caesar Creek Lake, East Fork Lake, C.J. Brown Reservoir, Rocky Fork Lake, LaDue Reservoir, Paint Creek Lake, the Portage Lakes, Mogadore Reservoir, Lake Loramie, Nimisila Reservoir, Cowan Lake, Acton Lake, Tappan Lake, Piedmont Lake, Clendening Lake, Atwood Lake, Charles Mill Lake, Pleasant Hill Lake and Beach City Lake Nov 9, 2026; Wingfoot Lake, East Branch Reservoir, Guilford Lake, Highlandtown Lake, Punderson Lake and Wellington Upground Reservoir Nov 10, 2026); evidence in the build notes. min is an estimated drive from the lake, rounded to 5 minutes; lists are in drive time order. lat/lng let a visitor sort from their own location on the device. A lake with an empty list shows No shops confirmed yet. q, when present, is the exact Google Maps search that opens that shop’s own listing (its name plus address opens another business at the same address).
